office: Millville Board of Education (3 full 3-year terms)
outlook: Contested: four candidates for three seats. Incumbency for Beatty and Lambert based on Ballotpedia terms ending 2026 and district board page; McQuade and Van Hook incumbency unverified.
impact: Lakeside Middle School (Millville Public Schools, Cumberland County) hosts what the school calls the 2nd NOLA Star Academy in New Jersey. This board approves the contract and budget that sustain the program.
result_note: Polls open; no results yet. Candidate list from Press of Atlantic City table, which was partly garbled; confirm against Cumberland County Clerk sample ballot.

office: Millville Board of Education (2-year unexpired term)
outlook: Appears uncontested; Flickinger is the only listed candidate. Incumbency inferred from Ballotpedia and district board page (unverified for this specific seat).
impact: Second Millville seat affecting governance of Lakeside Middle School, home of the district's Star Academy. Low stakes given a single candidate.
result_note: Single candidate per Press of Atlantic City listing.

office: Camden City School District Board of Education (advisory; 3 seats, 3-year terms)
outlook: Board is elected (since 2019) but advisory while the district remains under state control, so the superintendent and state hold most authority. Full candidate field unverified; only two Camden-address names on the 'Education For Everyone' slate were confirmed from the county list. Camacho was selected to the board in 2024; incumbency status for this race unverified.
impact: Innovator Academy at Morgan Village Middle School in the Camden City School District is the Star site. The board has limited formal power, but its members shape public discussion of district programs.
result_note: Camden County official school board candidate list exists but names could not be fully read.

office: Elko County School District Board of Trustees
outlook: District 1 is the confirmed contested race: incumbent Susan Neal vs. Tiffanie Eden. Brooke Williams Ballard filed for Seat 7 (3/9/2026); opposition and incumbency unverified. Other seats (e.g., District 6, 2B) unverified.
impact: Adobe Middle School is in the Elko County School District; trustees control the district budget and programs, including the Star Academy contract, amid declining enrollment discussions.
result_note: No primary for these seats. Results pending after polls close.

office: Barnwell County School District Board of Trustees (Areas 2 and 4)

candidates.name: Felicia Devore (Area 2, sitting trustee; candidacy unverified)
John Melton (Area 4, sitting trustee; candidacy unverified)

outlook: Under the consolidation statute, trustees elected in 2024 from even-numbered areas served initial two-year terms, so Areas 2 and 4 are up in Nov 2026 for full four-year terms. 2026 filed candidates not found; names listed are current seat holders only (unverified as candidates).
impact: Barnwell High School and Guinyard-Butler Middle School (formerly Barnwell 45, now part of the consolidated Barnwell County School District) both host Star sites, so two of five board seats on the newly consolidated board are at stake.
result_note: Candidate filings unverified; check Barnwell County Board of Voter Registration and Elections.

office: Logan County Board of Education (3 seats)
outlook: Decided in the May nonpartisan election. Marcum (board appointee) withdrew and endorsed White but stayed on the ballot. Burley Ferrell also appeared in one voter guide (unverified).
impact: Logan Middle School hosts a West Virginia Star Academy site. The new board takes office as the state returns policy-making authority to Logan County, giving members a direct say over the program going forward.
winner: Ed White, Bill Alderman, Tony Dean
result_note: Unofficial: White 2,151 (top vote-getter, former member); Alderman 1,364 def. former member Jason Cheek 1,092; Dean (District 3 incumbent) unopposed, 1,194; Marcum 714 after withdrawing. Certified canvass not verified.

office: Berkeley County Board of Education (May election, vote for three)
outlook: Candidate list from the May 12 primary sample ballot; additional filers (Katie Rose, Kevin H. Slack, others) appeared in the February filing list. Incumbency for all but Jenkins unverified.
impact: Martinsburg North Middle School (Berkeley County Schools) hosts a Star site; this board oversees program continuation.
result_note: Winners not verified; see Berkeley County Clerk 2026 primary results page.

office: Berkeley County Board of Education (unexpired term vacancy)
outlook: Wright holds the seat by interim appointment. Two-candidate field from a third-party listing (Spectrum Vote); unverified against official ballot.
impact: Fills a seat on the board overseeing Martinsburg North Middle School's Star site; the only Berkeley board seat on the Nov 3 ballot.
result_note: Filing window for the unexpired term was Aug 3-18, 2026.

outlook: Bond for districtwide renovations, a new middle school, and a career and technical education center; possible additional $25M from the WV School Building Authority.
impact: Capital funding for Berkeley County Schools, where Martinsburg North Middle hosts a Star site; a new middle school could affect middle-grade facilities and enrollment patterns.

office: Barbour County Board of Education (4 seats)
outlook: Four seats; no more than two members per magisterial district. Inter-Mountain headline reports new members elected. Incumbency of each candidate unverified.
impact: Philippi Middle School (Barbour County Schools) hosts a Star site; several new members now sit on the board that oversees the program.
winner: Ron Phillips, Ashley Ryan, Kristy Stalnaker, Johnna Croston
result_note: Unofficial (13 of 13 precincts): Phillips 988, Ryan 956, Stalnaker 920, Croston 799, McConnell 624, Everson 587. Certified totals not verified.

office: Kanawha County Board of Education (3 seats)
outlook: Newcomer Otey takes the seat previously held by Jim Crawford; two incumbents returned.
impact: West Side Middle School in Charleston (Kanawha County Schools) hosts a Star site; the board oversees the state's largest district.
winner: Lisa Otey, Becky Jones Jordon, Michael Arbogast
result_note: Unofficial: Otey 8,935, Williams 7,075, Brown 2,615 in District 1 count; Jordon and Arbogast final totals not verified.

office: Kanawha County Schools excess levy renewal
outlook: Renewal of a levy in place since 1937 that funds roughly a quarter of the district budget; one local report cites about $108M over five years with no rate increase (single source, unverified). Levy order dated Aug 3, 2026 states no excess levy funds go to public charter schools.
impact: A failed renewal would cut a large share of Kanawha County Schools' budget, putting discretionary programs such as the Star Academy at West Side Middle School under pressure.

office: Maricopa County school funding measures (no elected board for Career Success Schools)
outlook: Career Success Schools is a charter network governed by an appointed nonprofit board, with no elected governance on the ballot. No charter-specific Maricopa County ballot item found. Several district bond and override questions are on the Nov 3 ballot (e.g., Tolleson Union HSD), but none directly fund the charter.
impact: Career Success Schools campuses in Phoenix are Star sites; local district bond and override results affect the competitive and funding landscape but not the charter's budget directly.
